512-1719-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1719-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1251-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1818-5010-6495-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-6495-6900.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1818-5010-6495-6900.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-6495-7194.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7194.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-7194-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

4316-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3478-5411-6871-7115--44.description:

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

1874-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

215-1355-5434.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2232-2757-7404.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
You control a basic Forest.
2232-2757-7404.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact creature card in hand.
2232-2757-7404.description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Oviya by paying {G} and tapping it, putting a nonartifact creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature put onto the battlefield, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat.

423-1313-1437-3861.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-3861.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4364-4681-6332.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4050-4364-4681-6332.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Aurelia and Karmic Guide, adding {2}.
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
Repeat each combat phase.

579-2366-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Glint Hawk.

Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.

When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Aether Channeler
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1429-2511-6792.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

252-2073-5315--90.description:

When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

891-1585-2523-3967.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-1585-2523-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

When Minsc enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Boo legendary creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boo, adding {C}{C}.

4812-4846.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Animate Dead triggers, sacrificing Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
